--- title: "MockServer Performance Benchmarks: Throughput & Latency" description: "MockServer benchmarks: a six-core instance serves about 144,000 requests/sec at a sub-millisecond median; p99 within 10 ms outside load-generator GC pauses." layout: page lastmod: 2026-10-05T08:00:00+01:00 schema_faq: - question: "How fast is MockServer?" answer: "On six CPU cores a single instance holds a sub-millisecond median up to a healthy ceiling of about 144,000 requests/sec, serving roughly 143,700 req/s there with no errors at a median around 0.11 ms and a p95 of 7.3 ms. At the ceiling its 99th-percentile latency is 9.7 ms, within the 10 ms the test allows; with every second counted it was 44.9 ms. In the six like-for-like runs behind this figure the ceiling read 136,000 requests/sec in three and 144,000 in three. At 144,000 requests/sec all six held a sub-millisecond median, so provision against the lower rate, 136,000 requests/sec." - question: "How many requests per second can MockServer handle?" answer: "A single six-core instance served about 144,000 requests/sec (around 143,700 req/s achieved, no errors) at a sub-millisecond median, with a p99 within 10 ms and 44.9 ms with every second counted.
